name: js-range-header
instruction: Implement parseRange.js (CommonJS): module.exports = parseRange. parseRange(size, header) parses an RFC7233 Range header against a resource of `size` bytes. Return -2 if the header is malformed (missing, no '=', a range with neither start nor end, or a start greater than its end). Return -1 if every range is unsatisfiable (start >= size). Otherwise return an ARRAY of { start, end } with INCLUSIVE end, carrying a `type` property naming the unit (e.g. 'bytes'). An end past the last byte clamps to size-1. A suffix range '-N' means the LAST N bytes, and clamps to the whole resource when N >= size; '-0' is unsatisfiable. Unsatisfiable ranges are dropped from an otherwise satisfiable list, and the ranges are returned in the order given.
